_doc: Card effects (0.182, the owner's picks from the Card Lab, labs/cards/ COPY JSON). fx = the shader light behind every portrait (ui/cardFx.js): amt = how much light it adds, speed = how fast it moves, scale = the share of the card's pixels it is drawn at, fps = its frame rate, panelAmt = the light on the shrine boon and treasure chest cards (lighter cards, a touch more). Which look a card gets is ui/cardFx.js (by particle material: flesh blood, bone fog, ember flames, wraith ether, the boss flames, the knight ether; the boons and chests each their own). motion = the cards in 3D (ui/combatFx.js): a hit kicks the card kickDeg around its axis, away from the blow, snapping there and recovering over kickMs (a crit critKick times as far, a heavy blow heavyKick, an OVERKILL victim overkillKick); the room entrance deals the cards in over enterMs, enterDelayMs after the room shows and enterStaggerMs apart. glint = the sheen sweeping the portrait as the card turns (fxParts.js glintSweep): strength = its peak opacity, band = the band's half-width in % of the portrait, hitMs / enterMs = how long a sweep takes on a hit / the entrance.
